Method of Attack: Deploying a DaemonSet named 'proxy-api' to engage resources of all nodes in Kubernetes cluster simultaneously for mining Dero coin
Using a Docker image (modified CentOS 7) with files 'entrypoint.sh' (initializes miner with hardcoded wallet and pool) and 'pause' (actual miner binary)
Cryptojacking by mining Dero coin on Kubernetes clusters with exposed APIs and anonymous authentication enabled
Attack Vector: Scanning and exploiting exposed Kubernetes API with anonymous access
